changelog.title: What's new?
changelog.subtitle: Follow along as Metis evolves. Every version brings real improvements — no promises, just shipped work.
changelog.footer_part1: Metis is in pre-release — bugs are part of the deal. Found something?

p_0_9_9.label: Redesign: Plans + Coupons
p_0_9_9.entry_0: Full redesign of the Plans page with 4 tier cards, monthly/yearly toggle and new trust footer.
p_0_9_9.entry_1: Coupons feature — dedicated DB table with validity and effect, public endpoint, and "Available coupons" section on pricing.
p_0_9_9.entry_2: First live coupon: MESTRE2604 unlocks Premium with 10k tokens/day until the end of April.
p_0_9_9.entry_3: Comparison table, FAQ and Teams & Companies card now use the new design system.

p_0_9_8_1.label: Backend: Enriched item catalog
p_0_9_8_1.entry_0: `items` table in Supabase — name, gold, tags, category, trend in dedicated columns.
p_0_9_8_1.entry_1: Items endpoint returns gold cost, tags, and room for a curated category.
p_0_9_8_1.entry_2: Items page gained Category + Cost + Trend columns and tag chips next to the name.

p_0_9_8.label: Redesign: Items
p_0_9_8.entry_0: Items page redesigned with 2 spotlights (most bought / top winrate) and a dense table.
p_0_9_8.entry_1: Role, patch, search and sort filters preserved and restyled.

p_0_9_7.label: Redesign: Tier List
p_0_9_7.entry_0: Tier List reimagined as tier-grouped cards (S+ → C) with large portrait, colored WR and KDA/Ban/Games grid.
p_0_9_7.entry_1: Rank, role, patch range and search filters unified in one card.

p_0_9_6.label: Redesign: Home + Design System
p_0_9_6.entry_0: New home: hero with gold/cyan glow, top-3 meta spotlight, top-8 tier snippet with role filter.
p_0_9_6.entry_1: Real Sign in button in the header + avatar when logged in.
p_0_9_6.entry_2: Official Riot role icons on the role badges.
p_0_9_6.entry_3: Light mode removed — the new design is dark-only with customizable accent.
p_0_9_6.entry_4: Hover states back across buttons, cards and rows in the redesign.

p_0_9_5.label: Redesign: Foundation
p_0_9_5.entry_0: Foundation of the new design system — 18 primitives, new palette with LoL gold accent, Space Grotesk and JetBrains Mono fonts.

p_0_9_4.entry_0: Mobafire guide scraper storing raw HTML in Cloudflare R2 — foundation for future semantic analysis.
p_0_9_4.entry_1: Scraper bug that returned empty for every champion has been fixed.

p_0_9_3.entry_0: Admin panel got an "Update Tier List" button to clear the 24h cache.
p_0_9_3.entry_1: Tier list now filters unpopular picks by default — toggle to see all.

p_0_9_2.entry_0: Real pickrate and banrate on the tier list, with bans parsed from the match JSON.

p_0_9_0.label: Big Update · Metis Chat
p_0_9_0.entry_0: Pre-release 0.9.0 focused on Metis Chat quality.
p_0_9_0.entry_1: Topic guardrail — Metis now answers ONLY about League of Legends and rejects off-topic questions.
p_0_9_0.entry_2: Defined personality: calm, analytical, never toxic. Turns defeats into lessons.
p_0_9_0.entry_3: Daily token limit per plan — Donor (5k), Premium (30k), Pro (100k).
p_0_9_0.entry_4: Token usage bar in the chat — see how much of your limit you've used in real time.
p_0_9_0.entry_5: Chat upgraded to Gemini 2.5 Flash — a more capable model with sharper answers.

alpha_v0_8_2.label: Security Update
alpha_v0_8_2.entry_0: Full security update — every endpoint now requires internal authentication.
alpha_v0_8_2.entry_1: Internal API Key (X-API-Key) protects the whole API — unauthenticated access returns 403.
alpha_v0_8_2.entry_2: Sanitized error messages — internal details no longer leak to the client.
alpha_v0_8_2.entry_3: CORS restricted to specific methods and headers.
alpha_v0_8_2.entry_4: Gemini key configured securely — never stored in logs.
alpha_v0_8_2.entry_5: .gitignore blocks .env*, *.key and *.pem — impossible to commit secrets by accident.

alpha_v0_8_1.entry_0: Champion recommendations now use 8 dimensions (Neo-Artemis model).
alpha_v0_8_1.entry_1: More realistic scores — formula combines cosine with Euclidean distance.
alpha_v0_8_1.entry_2: Radar chart in the recommendation details — see your profile vs the champion.
alpha_v0_8_1.entry_3: Full rune map with correct icons on the Build tab.

alpha_v0_8_0.entry_0: Biggest update since launch — new interface, integrated AI, recommendations and monetization.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q_0: Can I cancel at any time?
faq.a_0: Yes — no penalty, no paperwork. Cancel directly from your account panel.
faq.a_1: You go back to the Free plan. Your data isn't deleted — only the premium perks stop.
faq.q_2: How does the AI Chat work?
faq.a_2: Metis analyzes your match data and answers tactical questions using Gemini 2.5 Flash with RAG over real game data.
faq.a_3: Yes. We accept PIX, credit card and boleto.
faq.q_4: What does the Donor plan help with?
faq.a_4: It helps keep the servers running and development active. You get extra perks as a thank-you.
